method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, reverse reconstruction of the finite-satisfiability analogues of complete-set closure, Henkin saturation, quantified instances and Lindenbaum completion, and replay of the resulting direct term-model or valuation proof, followed by exact formula, macro, controlled-token, tag, label, identifier and reference comparison. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: A direct proof of semantic compactness that replaces consistency by finite satisfiability throughout the canonical-model construction.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The direct proof reuses the completeness construction without invoking the Completeness Theorem: replace consistent by finitely satisfiable in each result leading to the Truth Lemma, then construct the same term model or propositional valuation.
samples.checks: Gamma, Gamma-star, FOL saturation, complete-set condition, term-model or valuation branch, truth and satisfiability conclusion are retained.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A complete finitely satisfiable set has the usual conjunction, disjunction and conditional membership laws; paired exercises request proofs without using derivability.
samples.checks: Every membership polarity, connective, both guarded exercise references and the explicit prohibition on Proves are exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: For FOL, every finitely satisfiable set extends to a saturated finitely satisfiable set, and a complete finitely satisfiable saturated set has the expected existential and universal closed-instance properties. Exercises request both proofs without consistency or derivations in the Henkin step.
samples.checks: Gamma-prime extension, Gamma_n union D_n, saturation, every closed-term quantifier and all fully qualified references are unchanged.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A finite-satisfiability Lindenbaum construction extends Gamma to a complete finitely satisfiable Gamma-star. The key stage chooses at least one of A_n and not-A_n while preserving finite satisfiability; paired FOL and propositional exercises request the proof.
samples.checks: Both candidate unions, negation, every stage index, language guard and reference are exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Satisfiability immediately implies finite satisfiability. Conversely, perform the finitely satisfiable Henkin and Lindenbaum extensions, construct the ordinary term model or valuation, observe that quantified term-model truth only needs coverage, and replay the Truth Lemma with the finite-satisfiability closure results.
samples.checks: All model or valuation branches, Gamma-prime and Gamma-star inclusions, completeness and saturation conditions, four local references and final replacement instructions are preserved. OLCOM-006 repairs the propositional tag scope of the prop:fsat-ccs replacement.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Paired exercises request the full adapted Truth Lemma for the FOL and propositional direct compactness proofs.
samples.checks: Both language guards and all fully qualified theorem and lemma references are unchanged.

source_observations: OLCOM-006 records that the frozen notFOL output omits the destination of its prop:ccs replacement because prop:fsat-ccs is scoped inside the FOL tag; the target preserves all references while applying that replacement to both builds.
The direct proof deliberately avoids the derivability and consistency route used in OLP-0135; the target retains every such restriction in the exercise prompts.
All formulas, macros, controlled tokens, tags, labels, identifiers and reference options match exactly.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The bulk of the direct proof is assigned as exercises in the frozen source and is therefore not expanded in the translation.
सांततः पूर्ततायोग्य remains expert-reviewable decision T199.
